name: Links and Worksets Audit
description: Read-only audit of linked models and worksets: unloaded or missing links, links that are not pinned, links placed Origin to Origin, empty or default-named worksets, worksets open by another user, and elements on the wrong workset for their category.
author: AEC Model Bridge

snapshot_id.description: Optional saved snapshot. Used to count elements per workset and to check categories against the workset mapping.

category_workset_map.description: Optional. Which workset each category belongs on, for example {"Walls": "Shared Architecture"}. Elements on a different workset are reported.

current_user.description: Your Revit username, so worksets you own are not reported as open by someone else.

expect_shared_coordinates.description: Report links placed 'Auto - Origin to Origin' as a warning. Default true.

links.description: Optional. Link data to audit instead of reading it live from Revit (output of revit_get_rvt_links).

link_instances.description: Optional. Link placement data (output of revit_get_link_instances).
